text.EN: Staying alive. Keep your eyes open.
text.TL: Basta buhay. Maging mapagmatyag.

text.EN: Watching the road. Don't stand in my line of sight.
text.TL: Binabantayan ang daan. Huwag kang humarang sa tingin ko.

text.EN: Alive, but cautious. You should be too.
text.TL: Buhay, pero maingat. Dapat ganoon ka rin.

text.EN: Just staying on high alert. Danger doesn't take days off.
text.TL: Laging alerto. Walang bakasyon ang panganib.

text.EN: Focusing on staying off the radar. Step aside.
text.TL: Nakatutok sa pananatiling tago. Tabi muna.

text.EN: Watching the fence lines. Nothing for you here.
text.TL: Binabantayan ang bakod. Walang kailangan dito.

text.EN: Alive, and keeping it that way by not gossiping.
text.TL: Buhay, at mananatiling ganito kung hindi makikipagtsismisan.

text.EN: Eyes on the horizon. Don't make unnecessary noise.
text.TL: Nakatitig sa abot-tanaw. Huwag gumawa ng ingay.

text.EN: Surviving. That requires vigilance, not conversation.
text.TL: Buhay pa. Kailangan 'yan ng pag-iingat, hindi ng daldalan.

text.EN: Just keeping myself safe. You do the same.
text.TL: Pinoprotektahan lang ang sarili ko. Gawin mo rin 'yan.

text.EN: Same as ever. Staying alive and watching the road.
text.TL: Gaya ng dati. Nanatiling buhay at binabantayan ang daan.

text.EN: Doing what needs to be done to see tomorrow.
text.TL: Ginagawa kung anong kailangan para makita ang bukas.

text.EN: One foot in front of the other. Road's quiet so far.
text.TL: Dahan-dahang naglalakad. Tahimik naman ang kalsada.

text.EN: Keeping a low profile and taking care of business.
text.TL: Umiiwas sa gulo at inaasikaso ang mga kailangan.

text.EN: Just staying alert out here. How have you been?
text.TL: Laging nagmamasid dito sa labas. Kumusta ka na?

text.EN: Watching the tree lines. Routine stuff.
text.TL: Binabantayan ang kakahuyan. Karaniwang gawain lang.

text.EN: Still on the right side of the dirt. That's plenty.
text.TL: Nasa ibabaw pa rin ng lupa. Sapat na 'yon.

text.EN: Taking each hour as it comes. How about yourself?
text.TL: Bawat oras kinakaya. Ikaw, kumusta ka?

text.EN: Alive and alert. Hoping the peace lasts.
text.TL: Buhay at gising. Sana magtagal ang katahimikan.

text.EN: Watching the perimeter, making sure we're unbothered.
text.TL: Binabantayan ang paligid para masigurong ligtas tayo.

text.EN: Staying alive.
text.TL: Basta buhay.

text.EN: Watching the road.
text.TL: Bantay sa daan.

text.EN: Same old.
text.TL: Ganoon pa rin.

text.EN: Alert.
text.TL: Alerto.

text.EN: On watch.
text.TL: Naka-duty.

text.EN: Still upright.
text.TL: Nakatayo pa.

text.EN: Road's clear.
text.TL: Ligtas ang daan.

text.EN: Keeping sharp.
text.TL: Matalas pa.

text.EN: Nothing to report.
text.TL: Walang bago.

text.EN: Breathing.
text.TL: Huminga pa.

text.EN: Same as ever. Staying alive and watching the road. What about you?
text.TL: Gaya ng dati. Nanatiling buhay at binabantayan ang daan. Ikaw, kumusta?

text.EN: Still here, still kicking. Seeing you makes the watch feel shorter.
text.TL: Nandito pa rin, lumalaban pa. Gumagaan ang bantay kapag nakikita kita.

text.EN: Watching the perimeter, but always glad to share a few words with you.
text.TL: Nagbabantay sa paligid, pero laging masayang makausap ka kahit saglit.

text.EN: Making sure the road stays safe for all of us. Hope you're doing well.
text.TL: Sinisigurong ligtas ang daan para sa ating lahat. Sana maayos ka.

text.EN: Alive and well, friend. Truly good to run into you today.
text.TL: Buhay at maayos, kaibigan. Masaya talaga akong nakasalubong kita ngayon.

text.EN: Taking in the daylight while we can. Glad you're walking safe.
text.TL: Nilalasap ang liwanag ng araw. Masaya akong naglalakad kang ligtas.

text.EN: Another day on our feet together. What could be better than that?
text.TL: Isa pang araw na magkasama tayong nakatayo. Ano pa bang mas maganda roon?

text.EN: Just keeping an eye out for our people. Thanks for checking in.
text.TL: Nagmamasid lang para sa kapakanan ng lahat. Salamat sa pangangamusta.

text.EN: Holding the line with a glad heart today. How are things on your end?
text.TL: Nagbabantay nang may magaan na loob ngayon. Kumusta sa parte mo?

text.EN: Still here, thankful for good companions like you. Stay safe.
text.TL: Nandito pa rin, nagpapasalamat sa mabubuting kasama tulad mo. Mag-ingat ka.
